evidence.title: GitHub - ourresearch/unpaywall-extension: Firefox/Chrome extension that gives you a link to a free PDF when you view scholarly articles · GitHub

name: Unpaywall
summary: Browser extension that links to free PDF copies of paywalled scholarly articles as you browse.
description: Open-source Firefox/Chrome extension in OurResearch's GitHub org: when you view a scholarly article, it gives you a link to a free PDF of it where one exists. The extension repository is MIT-licensed and has 526 stars. The unpaywall.org site itself renders only through JavaScript, so the wider set of Unpaywall products could not be read.
contains: Firefox/Chrome extension linking to free PDFs of scholarly articles
